text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world quickly, but it also raises important ethical questions. One major concern is bias. If AI systems learn from data that contains unfair human decisions, they may make biased choices, for example in hiring or lending. This threatens fairness, as some groups could be unfairly treated. Another issue is privacy. AI often collects and analyzes large amounts of personal data, so we need clear rules to protect individuals. To solve these problems, transparency is crucial. People should understand how AI makes decisions, especially in sensitive areas. Ultimately, responsible AI development means creating technology that is fair, respects privacy, and benefits everyone, not just a few.
